# Luere

> Luere is a free, private, native macOS app to compress, convert, crop and resize images. Everything runs on-device — nothing is uploaded. Tagline: "Smaller files. Same good looks."

Luere turns large images into small files without visibly hurting quality, with a live before/after preview so the user decides the trade between size and quality.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 26 or later. Native (not Electron).
- Price: 100% free — no account, no trial, no "Pro" tier.
- Privacy: all processing happens on the user's Mac; no uploads, no telemetry.

## Features
- Compression modes: Quality (manual), Target size (hit a byte budget), Web-optimized (one click).
- Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF.
- Live before/after compare preview at 100%.
- Crop Studio: crop, rotate, flip, straighten.
- Resize: longest edge, width, height, fit-within, percentage.
- Batch export; rename on export with a prefix/suffix.
- Metadata: keep or strip EXIF/GPS.
